# Indo Citra Jaya Sentosa

> Industrial solutions provider based in Pasuruan, East Java (Jawa Timur), Indonesia. Core services: industrial automation (PLC, SCADA, control panels) and HVAC (chillers, AHU, FCU, ducting), plus custom machinery, warehouse racking systems, forklift supply and servicing, and industrial parts repair. Operating since 2014; serves 50+ companies across East Java and the rest of Indonesia.

The website is published in two languages with identical content: English at the site root and Bahasa Indonesia under /id/.

## Key facts

- Name: Indo Citra Jaya Sentosa (also written "Indocitra")
- Location: Pasuruan, Jawa Timur (East Java), Indonesia
- Founded: 2014 (racking systems); industrial automation since 2020; custom machine manufacturing since 2024
- Sectors served: manufacturing, food and beverage, power, commercial
- WhatsApp: +62 812-3546-4274 (Fredy, sales and projects), +62 822-4522-5738 (Hilmy, operations)
- Email: indocitra.tech@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.indocitratech.com

## Services

- [Industrial Automation](https://www.indocitratech.com/services.html#automation): PLC programming (Siemens, Omron, Schneider Electric), SCADA design and implementation, safety device installation, control panel fabrication and wiring, industrial IoT and remote monitoring, commissioning.
- [HVAC Systems](https://www.indocitratech.com/services.html#hvac): system design and load calculation, chiller installation and integration, AHU, FCU and ducting works, chiller overhaul and servicing, refrigeration and cold storage, preventive maintenance.
- [Custom Machinery](https://www.indocitratech.com/services.html#machinery): custom machine design and fabrication, unscrambler and conveyor systems, automated production line equipment, factory acceptance testing, after-sales support.
- [Repair Industrial Parts](https://www.indocitratech.com/services.html#repair): compressors, conveyors, pumps, motors and drives, hydraulic and pneumatic systems, electrical panels, contract maintenance.
- [Racking Systems](https://www.indocitratech.com/services.html#racking): selective, drive-in, heavy-duty pallet and mezzanine racking, warehouse layout design, installation, safety inspection and load testing.
- [Forklift](https://www.indocitratech.com/services.html#forklift): forklift supply, electric and LPG forklift servicing, maintenance contracts, spare parts.
